title: Compute-primitive fingerprinting with per-job warm-start
creator: Maya Ortega
description: Build a model-agnostic fingerprinting and warm-start system that quickly identifies a small set of high-probability compute primitives (kernels/microkernels) for a request at runtime. The goal is to reduce online probing overhead and improve first-request latency for new or infrequent model variants while preserving long-term exploration for better throughput/cost. This ticket covers the fingerprint design, storage format, warm-start lookup, lightweight per-job microprobe, and runtime integration with the fallback/safety path.
goals: Reduce median first-request latency for cold model families by >= 30% compared to current conservative probe flow
Limit additional per-request CPU/GPU microprobe cost to < 3% of baseline throughput for steady-state workloads
Provide a compact, versioned fingerprint format compatible with Dedicated and Private deployments
Ship safe canary rollout with automatic rollback criteria tied to latency/cost regressions
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end prototype integrated into runtime chooser that returns 2-4 candidate primitives for prefill within 10ms on median path
Offline metrics validate that candidate set contains the empirically best primitive >= 90% of the time for held-out model/seqlen buckets
Canary on hosted runtime shows p95 latency unchanged and p50 improved by target on cold-start traffic at 1% traffic slice
Telemetry emits fingerprint hit/miss, warm-start success rate, probe cost, and regression alerts to Console
design_notes: Fingerprint composition: (model-fingerprint-hash, quantization-bitwidth, GPU-arch-hash, typical-seqlen-bucket, batch-size-range)
Two-tier lookup: exact hash lookup for warm-start vector + nearest-neighbor fallback based on seqlen/arch distance metric
Warm-start vector: small ranked list of kernel candidates with cached empirical lat/cost weights and last-probed timestamp
Microprobe: single-shot microbench of top-1 candidate for the active (seqlen,batch) bucket; results update vector and telemetry
Exploration policy: epsilon-decay bandit that slowly injects alternate kernels to avoid stagnation and adapt to perf drift
Storage: compact protobuf-serializable blobs persisted in runtime local kv with TTL and periodic refresh from central profile store
Safety: runtime fallbacks to robust default kernel and circuit-breaker on increased tail latency or memory errors
implementation_steps: Spec fingerprint schema and proto layout
Implement deterministic fingerprint hashing in model onboarding path
Warm-start lookup API in runtime chooser (read path only for Phase 1)
Lightweight microprobe harness callable from request path with strict timeout and budget
Bandit controller to decide occasional exploration and weight decay
Telemetry hooks and Console dashboards for hit/miss, probe cost, candidate ranking
E2E tests + load tests on staging cluster, then canary rollout in production
testing_plan: Unit tests for fingerprint encoding/decoding and nearest-neighbor distance calculations
Microbench suites across representative GPU types (v100/a100/h100 equivalent) and quantization profiles
Synthetic traffic experiments to validate latency and cost impact under mixed cold/warm workload
Chaos tests: forced kernel failures to validate fallback and circuit-breaker behavior
Long-running nightly job to verify exploration coverage and drift detection
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal staging runs with synthetic model family set (no traffic)
Phase 1: Canary 1% traffic for low-risk customers, monitor p50/p95/p999 and cost metrics for 48h
Phase 2: Expand to 10% with additional monitoring and SLO thresholds enforced
Phase 3: 50% expansion and finally 100% after 7 days of stable metrics
Rollback triggers: +10% p95, any p999 regression, increased error-rate or probe-cost > 5% of baseline
notes: Prefer conservative defaults for Private deployments where centralized profile store may be disabled
Keep the proto forward-compatible so we can add new contextual features (temperature, routing-tier) later
Coordinate with Solutions and SE for early adopter testing on Dedicated
